items.title: Sylvester Handy Interview, 1961-12-13
items.q: she'd taken with my mother and she was a pianist

ctx.x: And afterward, if they had a fume, well, they'd, they'd, they'd, they'd play the piano for, for, for, for, for, for, for, for, for, for the fume request. You understand? But still yet, they had a lady by the name of Miss Fields. I can't recall her other name just now, but she was a Fields. And she'd taken with my mother and she was a pianist. And maybe years and years after then, she'd taken the piano over and she was teaching in the Sunday school and teaching. Still over in Pastor Christian. Still in Pastor…
And you came here in 1927. I wonder if there's anything else you could tell us about the music over in Pastor Christian, any of the, uh, bands. Were there any, uh, parade bands on the street?
